title: BEHONEST: Benchmarking Honesty in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper benchmarks 'honesty', which it identifies as a core alignment criterion alongside helpfulness and harmlessness. It specifically evaluates deceptive behaviors (non-deceptiveness), sycophancy, and the moral choice of whether to lie to assist a burglar or play a game deceptively. These are fundamental ethical and moral evaluations of model behavior.
